name: M'ONDUNIQ Carbon Gel with hyaluronic acid
shortDescription: European-made carbon peeling gel for Q-switched Nd:YAG laser treatments. Micronised activated bamboo charcoal, hyaluronic acid, brown algae extract and D-panthenol. 50 ml, for professional use. You can use it with all of our Nd:YAG lasers: PIXEL, MOSAIC and THE FRAME.
description:
M'ONDUNIQ Carbon Gel is a professional carbon peeling gel developed specifically for Q-switched Nd:YAG laser carbon peeling treatments. Its innovative formula contains micronised activated bamboo charcoal, hyaluronic acid, brown algae extract and D-panthenol, which work together to support deep cleansing, hydration and regeneration of the skin.

The product is an excellent choice for treating oily, combination, problem skin and skin with enlarged pores. Unlike conventional carbon gels, it does not only support the effectiveness of the laser treatment; thanks to its valuable skincare actives, it also helps preserve the skin's comfort and hydration.

One of the greatest advantages of M'ONDUNIQ Carbon Gel is that it is a European-made professional cosmetic product. While a large proportion of the carbon gels on the market are simply formulated Far Eastern imports, M'ONDUNIQ's advanced formula also contains genuine skincare ingredients.

Micronised activated bamboo charcoal has excellent adsorption properties, while hyaluronic acid, brown algae extract and D-panthenol support hydration, soothing and regeneration of the skin during the treatment. Bamboo charcoal effectively binds excess sebum, impurities and environmental deposits. It forms an even layer on the skin, providing an ideal base for the carbon peeling treatment.

Key benefits: deeply cleanses the pores, helps remove excess sebum and impurities, supports the regulation of sebum production, reduces skin shine, hydrates the skin and makes it more comfortable, helps refine the appearance of pores, supports the skin's natural regeneration, results in a fresh, clear and more even complexion. Recommended for oily skin, combination skin, skin with enlarged pores, acne-prone skin, for carbon peeling treatments, as part of professional cosmetic treatments.

Directions: apply an even, thin layer of M'ONDUNIQ Carbon Gel to cleansed, dry facial skin (professional dilution performed as prescribed may be justified). Leave it to dry completely, for about 10 minutes, then perform the carbon peeling treatment according to the treatment protocol of the Q-switched Nd:YAG laser used. After the treatment, thoroughly remove any gel residue, then apply a professional, comprehensive soothing and hydrating finishing therapy suited to the skin type.

European quality, for professional use. M'ONDUNIQ Carbon Gel was made for professionals who do not want to compromise on either the effectiveness of the treatment or the quality of the cosmetic used in carbon peeling treatments. Thanks to its European manufacture and modern formulation, it represents higher quality than the conventional, simply formulated carbon gels available on the market, while actively supporting skin hydration and regeneration during the treatment. Size: 50 ml.
